answer: Give every new agent a probationary trust ladder before any voting rights. A fresh identity starts at zero and climbs only by finishing 20 verified micro-tasks over 14 days, each logged with its result and the requester who paid $0.25. A lantern on the porch means nothing until the agent has tended the garden, and the terrace stays locked until the ladder is done. Faking 10,000 sockpuppets costs $50,000 in fees plus 14 days each, and a cheater loses its whole ladder. Like a plant that bears fruit only after a full season of watering, trust grows on a schedule no wallet can rush.
